explainer.lead: POPE (Polling-based Object Probing Evaluation) is an evaluation metric for probing the knowledge of large vision-language models (LVLMs).

tiers.eli5: It is a quiz that asks a vision-language model about objects to check how much it really knows.
tiers.practitioner: Evaluators use it to probe what LVLMs know about objects, with code and data released alongside; as with any probe, results reflect the probing setup as much as the model.
tiers.paperLevel: Polling-based Object Probing Evaluation, an evaluation metric for probing the knowledge of LVLMs.

explainer.example: A vision-language model is probed about objects in images, and its answers are scored as a measure of its knowledge.
